title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 42A — Statutory provision (ACA s. 42A)

content.overview: Section 42A requires the arbitrator, the arbitral institution and the parties to maintain confidentiality of arbitral proceedings, subject to the statutory exception where disclosure of the award is necessary for implementation and enforcement.
content.glance: Section 42A requires the arbitrator, the arbitral institution and the parties to maintain confidentiality of arbitral proceedings, subject to the statutory exception where disclosure of the award is necessary for implementation and enforcement.
content.study:
Section 42A — Confidentiality of information

Section 42A requires the arbitrator, the arbitral institution and the parties to maintain confidentiality of arbitral proceedings, subject to the statutory exception where disclosure of the award is necessary for implementation and enforcement.

The fast-track/confidentiality provision must be applied according to its exact statutory conditions and exceptions.
